files.description: Chapter 1: every novel drug approved since 2015 with a parsed FDA Drug Trials Snapshot, its FAERS adverse-event report split by sex, and (where available) MEPS prescription users by sex.

columns.brand: Brand name as on the FDA snapshot
columns.category: Therapeutic area assigned by keyword rules on the FDA indication text
columns.trial_n: Participants counted in the snapshot's demographics tables (may double-count overlapping populations; use the share, not the count)
columns.trial_female_pct: Share of pivotal-trial participants who were women
columns.enrollment_source: fda-snapshot, or carmeli-2023 where the archived page could not be retrieved
columns.faers_n: FAERS reports with a recorded sex (openFDA, brand-name query)
columns.faers_female_pct: Share of those reports from women
columns.meps_users_n: Unweighted MEPS person-years with a fill, 2018-2024
columns.meps_female_pct: Weighted share of users who are women
columns.rate_ratio: (female:male reports) / (female:male users); lo/hi are a 95% interval from the survey share's sampling error

files.description: Chapter 2: survey-weighted estimates by patient sex for NHAMCS ED visits 2018-2022, adults 18+, by pain complaint and for heart-attack visits.

columns.complaint: Reason-for-visit group (abdominal, chest, back, headache, limb, flank, all) or heart_attack (ICD-10 I21/I22 in any diagnosis)
columns.measure: See the Methods page: shares are percentages, wait_mean and lov_mean are minutes, tests_count is a count
columns.women_n/men_n: Unweighted sampled visits in the estimate
columns.lo/hi: 95% confidence interval, Taylor linearization over strata and PSUs

files.description: Chapter 2: the same estimates by complaint and age band (18-44, 45-64, 65+, all).
Chapter 3: 67 diseases with NIH FY2024 funding matched to WHO 2021 US burden by sex.

columns.female_share: Share of DALYs falling on women
columns.disability_share: YLD as a share of DALYs
columns.expected_m: Fitted funding from the power law of funding on burden
columns.skew: female (>=60% women), male (>=60% men) or balanced

files.description: Chapter 3: NIH funding by fiscal year 2008-2025 for each matched disease, $ millions (0 means the category was not yet reported).
Chapter 3: NIH-funded conditions with no WHO burden estimate, FY2024 funding in $ millions.
